measurement: UTF-8 bytes of compact JSON with no BOM or insignificant whitespace; JSONL adds exactly one LF byte. Integers only; booleans are not numeric values. No coercion, truncation or silent clamping.

message_bytes.scope: Each complete request, result or event in either direction
message_bytes.rationale: Small status/preferences need no bulk channel

string_bytes.scope: Each string value and object key inside an envelope
string_bytes.rationale: Bounds text allocation independently of character count

identifier_bytes.scope: Each correlation, generation, operation and subscription identifier
identifier_bytes.rationale: Opaque IDs fit without accepting free-form descriptions

container_items.scope: Each array length and each object own-key count

message_nodes.scope: All JSON values, including containers, in one envelope

message_depth.scope: JSON root depth is one; each container child adds one
message_depth.rationale: No recursive research documents on initial port

pending_per_window.scope: Unsettled requests admitted from one live window

pending_global.scope: All unsettled requests across broker and service
pending_global.rationale: Aggregate cap prevents multiplication by windows

windows.scope: Application windows attached to the single broker

subscriptions_per_window.scope: Active status or preference subscriptions in one window
subscriptions_per_window.rationale: Initial surfaces require few live streams

event_queue_bytes.scope: Sum of encoded complete events per subscription
event_queue_bytes.rationale: Count and byte caps apply together

request_deadline_ms.scope: Status and preference requests from admission to reply; includes queues
request_deadline_ms.rationale: Short local operations must return control promptly

service_start_ms.scope: Utility spawn to authenticated ready handshake
service_start_ms.rationale: Allows cold native startup without indefinite waits

application_start_ms.scope: Process launch to responsive bootstrap/status surface; excludes human choice and migration
application_start_ms.rationale: A visible recovery surface bounds first-use waiting

shutdown_grace_ms.scope: Normal data-service drain and close after confirmed exit decision

shutdown_termination_ms.scope: Escalation to verified owned local-tree cessation receipt
shutdown_termination_ms.rationale: Bounds termination observation without fabricating cessation

shutdown_total_ms.scope: Confirmed quit to clean process-tree exit; excludes human save/discard decision

process_tree_count.scope: Broker, all renderer/GPU/network/crash helpers and utility descendants
process_tree_count.rationale: Includes Electron helpers; not only application JS processes

process_tree_rss_bytes.scope: Sum of resident working sets across complete owned tree during initial journeys
process_tree_rss_bytes.rationale: Conservative 1 GiB envelope on 8 GiB reference hardware

process_tree_cpu_ms.scope: Sum of user plus system CPU over initial-operation measurement window
process_tree_cpu_ms.rationale: Bounds active CPU across cores rather than wall time alone

measurement_window_ms.scope: Launch, ready, status read, appearance read/change and orderly shutdown fixture
measurement_window_ms.rationale: Same finite synthetic journey on each native target

initial_input_bytes.scope: Payload only for each initial status or appearance read/change operation
initial_input_bytes.rationale: No research text or arbitrary preference records

initial_input_items.scope: Total own fields in initial operation payload
initial_input_items.rationale: Named operations have small explicit shapes

initial_output_bytes.scope: Payload only for each initial operation result
initial_output_bytes.rationale: Allows bounded component identities and controlled codes

initial_work_units.scope: One status snapshot, preference read or atomic appearance replacement per request
initial_work_units.rationale: No batches or hidden research work

sqlite_busy_ms.scope: Busy timeout on initial operational data-service connection
sqlite_busy_ms.rationale: Leaves time for bounded request handling

automatic_service_restarts.scope: Automatic service restarts per app session after proven cessation
automatic_service_restarts.rationale: No crash/restart loop; never replays mutations

locator_bytes.scope: Fixed locator file; inherited from architecture bootstrap contract

diagnostic_event_bytes.scope: Complete UTF-8 JSONL event including LF

diagnostic_queue_items.rationale: No write backlog growth on denied or slow I/O

diagnostic_queue_bytes.scope: Sum of complete encoded queued diagnostic events

diagnostic_file_bytes.scope: Each log file; inherited from ADR-0013

diagnostic_files.scope: Active plus archives; inherited from ADR-0013

setup_active_ms.scope: Contributor active work from clean checkout to local unsigned package
setup_active_ms.rationale: Initial 60 minute acceptance hypothesis, not measured universal performance

setup_cold_download_ms.scope: Separately timed aggregate cold download wall time
setup_cold_download_ms.rationale: Initial 30 minute reference-network envelope; never hides active work

ci_retention_days.scope: Disposable quality packages and review artifacts after run
ci_retention_days.rationale: Bounded review window; permanent release storage is separate

release_retirement_notice_days.scope: Minimum public notice before retiring a supported release baseline
release_retirement_notice_days.rationale: Provides an explicit upgrade/recovery transition window

update_catalog_bytes.rationale: Bound parsing and retained update metadata

update_catalog_packages.scope: Package entries in one signed catalog
update_catalog_packages.rationale: Cover required profiles and retain bounded admission work

update_package_bytes.scope: One complete final installation or update artifact

update_download_ms.rationale: Bound interrupted or stalled download duration

update_catalog_lifetime_ms.rationale: Bound offline replay exposure to seven days

update_operator_ms.scope: One explicitly authorized external native operator handoff
update_operator_ms.rationale: Bound an unattended internal qualification handoff independently of network transfer time
